description: Resize a page (Page.resize). With REPLACING/ADDING, width and height are lengths in mm; with MULTIPLYING they are scale factors; with RESHAPING_* they are a width:height ratio.

anchorPoint.description: Point of the page that stays fixed while it resizes

coordinateSpace.description: Coordinate space the size is measured in; PAGE_COORDINATES unless you need another

height.description: Height value (mm, factor or ratio part depending on resizeMethod)

resizeMethod.description: How width and height are applied: replace the size (default), multiply it, add to it, or reshape to a ratio

width.description: Width value (mm, factor or ratio part depending on resizeMethod)

name: resize_page
title: Resize Page
